correctness.rationale: For q any prime power, n>=2 and each d_i>=3 with nonconstant branch-length vector, m/m^2 preserves the independent x_j^2 classes, so the relation x_i x_k=0 forces a monomial invertible linear matrix. For any off-principal target branch, a product with its principal preimage gives annihilator (x_j^{d_j-1}); nilpotency of phi(x_i) forces d_sigma(i)<=d_i, and equality follows over the permutation. Conversely principal truncated substitutions plus arbitrary off-branch top socle terms preserve mixed and power relations and invertible cotangent yields an automorphism of finite local algebra. Independent direct enumeration of two-branch (q,d)=(2;(3,4)) by enumerating all possible two generator images, checking all power and cross relations and determinant gives exactly 32, matching (product m_r!)(q-1)^n q^{sum(d_i-2)+n(n-1)}. This finite check corroborates but does not establish the universal theorem; its five-step proof does.
